subject: Weekly MAP: Budget & credit alignment for Delta Systems
messages:
From: Olivia Chan <olivia.chan@deltasys.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@deltasys.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline and initial budget ask

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Delta has pushed our Q3 procurement planning up and we need to lock in MAP economics and a close window. High level ask from my side: can Redwood provide a committed spend proposal for 12 months with an onboarding credit and a one-time discount to help hit our internal thresholds?

Numbers we'd like to model: $150,000 commit over 12 months in exchange for a 20% list discount + $25,000 onboarding credit. That would clear our internal gating. If that's not feasible, please advise what levers you can pull (commit sizing, credit, shorter ramp) so I can run it with finance.

We'd like a short weekly checkpoint (15-30m) between now and the procurement approval the week of Jul 5. Can you propose a standing slot?

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Chan
Director, Strategic Procurement
Delta Systems
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chan <olivia.chan@deltasys.com>
Cc: avery.johnson@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline and initial budget ask

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clarity.

Short answer: we can structure a MAP to support a procurement gating like you described, but we need to align internally on discount vs. credit vs. commit sizing. I attached a draft MAP (Delta_MAP_v3.xlsx) with milestones, acceptance criteria, and several pricing scenarios to discuss.

Proposed next steps:
- Weekly checkpoint: Tue mornings 8:30 PT (15 min) starting Jun 22 — proposal open if you'd prefer a different time.
- Redwood offers: preliminary scenario A (100k commit / $20k credit / 15% discount), scenario B (125k commit / $25k credit / 17% discount), scenario C (150k commit / $25k credit / 20% discount) — internal approvals required for the higher discounts.

I'll loop in finance and our deals lead to get a firm answer on approvals and any gating for marketplace/contracting.

Attachments: Delta_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline and initial budget ask

Heads up — quick internal note.

I reviewed the attached MAP. Initial finance posture: $100k commit easily approvable with $15-20k credit and up to 15% discount. Anything above $120k commit requires escalation to revenue ops for discount >15% or approval from my manager.

My recommendation: offer scenario B (125k / $25k credit / 17% discount) as a negotiable opening if revenue ops can sign off; otherwise start at scenario A and present a fast escalation path tied to a signed LOI/PO.

I'll coordinate with Avery today to get a firm position by end of week.

– Dev
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chan <olivia.chan@deltasys.com>
Cc: avery.johnson@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai, procurement@deltasys.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + agenda for weekly checkpoints

Hi Olivia — attaching the redlined MAP and a short SOW stub for procurement review (SOW_Delta-v1.docx).

Agenda for our first weekly checkpoint (Jun 22):
1) Confirm target commit figure and preferred pricing scenario
2) Review acceptance criteria and timeline (PO/LOI -> SSO enablement -> POC -> GA)
3) Identify procurement docs needed to circulate this week (SOW, PO template, security questionnaire answers)

Quick ask to Delta: please confirm whether procurement requires a vendor/contractor onboarding packet or a standard PO only. Also confirm whether the $150k scenario is the preference or if you would accept $125k with faster sign-off.

Attachments: Delta_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_Delta-v1.docx

Cheers,
Tessa
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + agenda for weekly checkpoints

Tessa — finance note and approval envelope:

- Approve up to $20,000 onboarding credit for this deal without further sign-off if commit >= $100k.
- Approve discounts up to 15% for commit >= $100k.
- For discounts between 15-20% we need revenue ops sign-off; for discounts >20% require VP approval.

If Delta can commit to $125k, we can route revenue ops for a one-off 17% discount (conditional on signed LOI and PO within 2 weeks). I'm putting a soft hold on the $25k credit until we see the signed LOI — $20k credit now, $5k contingent on meeting the integration milestones in the MAP.

I'll have procurement/legal standby to draft the SOW once Dev confirms the discount envelope.

- Avery
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chan <olivia.chan@deltasys.com>, procurement@deltasys.com
Cc: avery.johnson@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP proposal for procurement review and next steps

Redwood offer (final draft):
- Commit: $125,000 over 12 months
- Discount: 15% base + potential uplift to 17% pending revenue ops sign-off after LOI
- Onboarding credit: $20,000 at signing, additional $5,000 payable upon completion of MAP milestone M2 (POC acceptance)
- Target close window: signed LOI/PO by Jun 30, SOW signed and onboarding kickoff Jul 6

Key meeting notes & action items (Weekly MAP checkpoint, Jun 21):
- Agreed standing meeting time: Tue 08:30 PT weekly beginning Jun 22 (owner: Tessa)
- Delta will confirm procurement packet requirements (owner: Olivia) — due Jun 24
- Redwood to provide SOW draft and final MAP file (owner: Dev) — SOW_Delta-v1.docx shared; final by Jun 24
- Finance to confirm final discount envelope and credit schedule (owner: Avery) — decision: $20k credit now, $5k contingent; confirm by Jun 24
- Legal to prepare SOW and standard terms once LOI received (owner: LegalOps) — placeholder: legalops@redwood.ai
